panels.action: Saint Mirren International University rooftop terrace in heavy torrential rainstorm, dark ominous storm clouds with distant lightning flashes over modern glass skyscrapers
panels.mood: gloomy, heavy rain, dramatic dark sky

bubbles.text: DUNIYA KE IS SABSE BADE ACADEMY MEIN...

panels.prose_hi: Saint Mirren International University ki chhat par toofani baarish ka keher baras raha tha. Aasmaan mein kaale manhoos baadal mandra rahe the aur door shehar ke aalishaan skyscrapers ke beech aasmaani bijli ki chamak andhere ko cheer rahi thi.
panels.prose_en: A torrential rainstorm battered the expansive rooftop terrace of Saint Mirren International University. Heavy, bruised storm clouds churned overhead as distant jagged lightning illuminated the silhouettes of towering corporate skyscrapers.

panels.action: Rainwater puddle reflecting Ha-Jun's battered face. A drop of fresh crimson blood falls from his split lip, creating circular ripples in the dark reflective water

bubbles.text: SIRF TAQATWAR LOG HI SURVIVE KAR SAKTE HAIN.

panels.prose_hi: Thande concrete par bhare hue paani ke gaddhe mein satra saal ke Ha-Jun Kang ka zakhmi aur lahu-luhan chehra saaf jhalak raha tha. Uske phate hue honth se laal khoon ki ek garam boond tapak kar paani mein giri, aur kaanpte hue ripples banati chali gayi.
panels.prose_en: In a shallow puddle gathering on the concrete floor, the battered reflection of seventeen-year-old Ha-Jun Kang flickered in the dark water. A fresh drop of crimson blood spilled from his split lower lip, sending fragile ripples spreading across his image.

panels.action: Ha-Jun Kang slumps his drenched back against the wet concrete parapet, head bowed, rain dripping from his black fringe, chest heaving
panels.prose_hi: Apni bheegi hui peeth ko chhat ki thandi deewar se tekte hue, Ha-Jun ne sar jhukaye behad mushkil se saans li. Kaale baalon ki bheegi laton se paani uske maathe par beh raha tha, aur seena dard se buri tarah haanp raha tha.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slumped his drenched back against the cold concrete parapet, head bowed low. Frigid rainwater streamed through the soaked black bangs plastered to his forehead as his chest heaved in ragged, breathless gasps.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's right hand clutching his bruised ribs through his soaked navy school blazer. Scraped knuckles bleeding, fabric drenched

bubbles.text: HAR ROZ... YAHI KHEL CHALTA HAI.

panels.prose_hi: Usne apne kaanpte hue zakhmi haath se apni chhati aur pasliyon ko kaske pakad liya. Uska navy academy blazer keechad aur paani se bhiga hua tha, aur uski chheeli hui ungliyon se ab bhi khoon ris raha tha. Pura jism aag ki tarah jal raha tha.
panels.prose_en: Clutching his bruised ribs through his waterlogged navy academy blazer, he winced at the burning ache inside his torso. His scraped knuckles oozed blood, the fabric of his uniform ruined by another day of merciless violence.

panels.action: Ha-Jun slowly lifts his bruised chin, eyes staring blankly at the stormy sky above, raindrops splashing across his cheeks
panels.prose_hi: Dard se karahate hue, Ha-Jun ne dheere se apni thodi upar uthayi aur aasmaan se girti hui beraham boondon ko dekha. Uski thaki hui aankhon mein ek ajeeb sa sunn-pan tha... lekin unhi aankhon ke kone mein ek ziddi aag bhi dafan thi.
panels.prose_en: With slow, agonizing effort, Ha-Jun tilted his chin toward the pouring heavens. Cold raindrops pelted his bruised cheekbones as he stared into the storm with hollow, exhausted eyes, struggling to comprehend the cruelty of his fate.

panels.action: Ha-Jun glances toward the metal terrace railing where the demonic bird Kuro had perched moments ago
panels.prose_hi: Achanak use wo ajeeb sa lamha yaad aaya. Usne mudkar terrace ki lohe ki railing ki taraf dekha, jahan kuch hi pal pehle wo ajeeb kaala parinda baitha tha.
panels.prose_en: Then, memory stirred through the haze of pain. Ha-Jun turned his gaze toward the perimeter railing where that uncanny feathered creature had perched only moments ago.

panels.action: The rusted wet metal railing where Kuro sat. Faint wisps of purple smoke and neon violet sparks dissipate into the pouring rain
panels.prose_hi: Railing par ab sirf zang aur paani ke katre the. Parinde ki jagah par baingani dhuan aur halki violet chingaariyan hawa mein ghulkar gayab ho rahi thi, jaise wo kisi doosri duniya ki makhlooq ho.
panels.prose_en: The iron bar stood empty in the downpour, glistening with rust and rainwater. Yet clinging to the metal were faint wisps of dark violet smoke and dissipating purple sparks, vanishing slowly into the deluge.

panels.action: Ha-Jun sitting alone on the vast empty concrete rooftop terrace in torrential rain, looking around in bewilderment

bubbles.text: WO KOI AAM PARINDA TOH NAHI THA...

panels.prose_hi: Toofani baarish ke beech Ha-Jun is vishaal chhat par bilkul akela baitha tha. Thandi hawayen uske jism ko cheer rahi thi, lekin uska dhyan bhatak chuka tha.
panels.prose_en: He was utterly alone on the vast, rain-swept expanse of the rooftop. The biting wind cut through his drenched shirt, but the sheer unreality of what he had witnessed refused to leave his mind.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's tired dark brown eyes suddenly widen in surprise as a strange light catches his peripheral vision
panels.prose_hi: Tabhi... andheri chhat ke farsh par kuch chamka. Ha-Jun ki thaki hui aankhein achanak hairat se phail gayi jab uski nigaah ek anokhi roshni par padi.
panels.prose_en: Suddenly, an unnatural gleam caught the corner of his eye. Ha-Jun's dark pupils widened in sharp disbelief as a radiant shimmer flickered against the wet pavement.

panels.action: A solitary obsidian-black demonic feather rests on the dark rain-slicked concrete floor, radiating a soft hypnotic violet-magenta magical glow
panels.prose_hi: Chhat ke farsh par, baarish ke gaddhe ke beech ek akela obsidian kaala pankh pada hua tha. Wo koi aam pankh nahi tha—uske kinaron se halki, mantramugdha kar dene wali baingani roshni nikal rahi thi jo andhere mein chamak rahi thi.
panels.prose_en: Lying solitary upon the dark concrete was an obsidian-black feather. It radiated an ethereal, hypnotic violet-magenta glow, casting soft purple light into the surrounding rainwater.

panels.action: Ha-Jun pushes himself off the wet wall, crawling forward on hands and knees through rain puddles toward the glowing feather

bubbles.text: USKI EK PANKH... YAHAN CHHOOT GAYI HAI.

panels.prose_hi: Deewar se sahara chhodte hue, Ha-Jun apne dono haathon aur ghutno ke bal paani ke gaddhon mein rengte hue aage badha. Uske mann mein ek ajeeb sa kheenchaav tha jo use us pankh ki taraf kheench raha tha.
panels.prose_en: Pushing himself away from the retaining wall, Ha-Jun dropped to his hands and knees. An irresistible gravity pulled at his chest, compelling him to crawl through the icy puddles toward the fallen plume.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's scuffed sneakers and trembling hands splashing in dark rainwater ripples as he inches closer
panels.prose_hi: Uske ghise hue joote aur kaanpte hue zakhmi haath paani par chhap-chhap karte hue aage badh rahe the. Har qadam ke saath paani ke chheente ud rahe the aur uske seene ki dharakan tez hoti ja rahi thi.
panels.prose_en: His scuffed school shoes scraped the concrete as his trembling, bloodied palms splashed through ripples of dark water, inching closer with every ragged breath.

panels.action: Extreme close-up of the demonic feather. Obsidian black plumage with deep purple iridescent sheen. Raindrops touching the feather instantly sizzle into tiny wisps of steam
panels.prose_hi: Pankh ke kareeb aate hi ek anokha nazaara dikha. Aasmaan se girti hui baarish ki thandi boondein jaise hi us baingani pankh ko chhooti, wo foran chhan-chhan ki aawaz ke saath garam bhaap aur nanhi chingaariyon mein badal kar ud jaati thi!
panels.prose_en: Up close, the feather defied all laws of reality. Its obsidian barbs shimmered with deep purple iridescence, and every raindrop that struck its surface instantly sizzled, evaporating into curls of fragrant violet steam.

panels.action: Ha-Jun kneeling in front of the feather, water streaming down his face, mesmerized by the glowing violet light
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun us pankh ke theek saamne ghutno ke bal baith gaya. Paani uske maathe aur gaalon se beh raha tha, lekin uski nigahein us baingani noor par aakar jam gayi thi. Wo palke jhapakna bhi bhool gaya tha.
panels.prose_en: Kneeling directly before the object, water pouring down his battered face, Ha-Jun found himself utterly spellbound. The soft purple radiance bathed his weary features in otherworldly light.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's heartbeat pounding against his soaked white shirt under his loosened navy tie

bubbles.text: ISME SE EK AJEEB SI GARMAHAT AA RAHI HAI.

panels.prose_hi: Is thithurti hui thandi mein bhi, Ha-Jun ko apne seene mein ek anokhi garmahat mehsoos hone lagi. Uski dharakan achanak itni tez ho gayi jaise uska dil seene ko cheer kar bahar aane wala ho.
panels.prose_en: Despite the freezing rain soaking through his skin, a strange, comforting warmth pulsed beneath his ribcage. His heart thudded furiously against his collarbone, resonating in tandem with the feather.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's slender, trembling right hand hovering just 2 inches above the glowing obsidian feather on the wet floor. Complete silence
panels.prose_hi: Usne apna kaanpta hua dahina haath aage badhaya. Uski chheeli hui ungliyan us chamakte hue pankh se mehaz do inch ki doori par thahar gayi. Chhat par chhayi toofani aawazon ke beech jaise ek pal ke liye sab kuch shaant ho gaya.
panels.prose_en: Trembling with anticipation, Ha-Jun reached out his right hand. His fingertips hovered merely inches above the quill, the howling storm around him fading into absolute, breathless silence.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's bruised index finger makes physical contact with the soft quill of the feather
panels.prose_hi: Aur phir... Ha-Jun ki ungli ne us pankh ke mulayam quill ko chhoo liya.
panels.prose_en: Then, steeling his resolve, his bruised index fingertip made contact with the soft, glowing quill.

panels.action: A subtle ring of glowing violet mana ripples outward through the rain on the concrete floor from the point of contact
panels.prose_hi: Chhoote hi, contact point se baingani mana ki ek circular shockwave phoot padi! Paani ke gaddhon mein baingani roshni ki leharein tezi se chaaro taraf fail gayi, aur hawa mein mana ki chingaariyan chamak uthi.
panels.prose_en: The moment flesh touched quill, a circular shockwave of radiant violet mana erupted across the pavement! Water droplets shattered into glowing purple rings, rippling outward across the dark terrace.

panels.action: Ha-Jun flinches backward slightly, his pupils contracting in shock as an electric sensation travels up his fingertips
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun jhatke se peeche hata. Ek tez electric jhatka uski ungliyon se shuru hokar uske poore baazu mein daud gaya tha. Uski aankhein hairat aur darr se phail gayi.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun flinched backward in shock as a surge of electric power coursed through his fingertips and up his forearm, his pupils contracting at the sharp, tingling jolt.

panels.action: Ha-Jun carefully lifts the glowing feather into his palm, holding it close to his chest. The purple glow softly illuminates his bruised face

bubbles.text: JAISE YE MUJHE PEHLE SE JAANTI HO...

panels.prose_hi: Lekin darr ke bajaye, uske andar ek be-inteha chahat jaag uthi. Usne dono haathon se us baingani pankh ko utha liya aur apne seene ke kareeb le aaya. Uski roshni Ha-Jun ke zakhmi chehre ko chamka rahi thi.
panels.prose_en: Yet the shock carried no malice. Gently, reverently, Ha-Jun scooped the obsidian feather into his cupped palms, drawing it close to his chest as its violet glow illuminated his tear-streaked face.

panels.action: Heavy rain pouring down on Ha-Jun as he stares at the feather in his cupped hand, dark wet hair plastered across his forehead
panels.prose_hi: Toofani baarish mein us pankh ko dekhte hue, Ha-Jun ke seene mein ek ajeeb sa sukoon bhar gaya... ek aisi garmahat jise wo sadiyon se dhoond raha tha.
panels.prose_en: Sitting in the deluge, gazing down at the burning feather cradled in his hands, an overwhelming wave of familiarity washed over his soul—a warmth he had not felt in years.

panels.action: Silhouette memory: 5 years ago in pouring rain, Ha-Jun's elder brother holding his little hand, smiling gently under an umbrella

bubbles.text: "HA-JUN, JAB TAK MAIN HOON... TUJHE DARNE KI ZAROORAT NAHI."

panels.prose_hi: Achanak uske dimaagh mein paanch saal purani ek yaad taaza ho gayi. Barsaat ki aisi hi ek raat mein, uske bade bhai ne uska nanha haath thama tha aur chhatri ke neeche muskurate hue use hausla diya tha...
panels.prose_en: A memory flickered across his mind from five years ago: another rainy evening, when his elder brother had wrapped an umbrella over his head, holding his little hand with that gentle, protective smile...

panels.action: Back to reality: Ha-Jun's face contorts in overwhelming grief. Tears mix with rain, spilling down his bruised cheeks
panels.prose_hi: Yaad aate hi Ha-Jun ka dil toot gaya. Haqeeqat ka dukh uske seene mein khanjar ki tarah utar gaya. Baarish ke paani ke saath milkar uske garam aansu uske zakhmi gaalon par behne lage.
panels.prose_en: The memory broke through his defenses. Agony and grief crushed his chest as hot tears mixed with the cold rain, tracing down his bruised cheeks in silent agony.

panels.action: Ha-Jun curls forward, his left hand clutched tightly over his collarbone and throat in choked sobs, holding the feather tightly in his other hand
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun aage jhuk gaya aur rone laga. Ek haath se gale ko pakadte hue aur doosre haath mein pankh ko kaske thaamte hue, uske hontho se bebasi ki aah nikal padi.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun bent forward, his voice choking in suffocating sobs. Clutching the feather against his collarbone, five years of repressed sorrow poured out into the howling storm.

panels.action: In rising anguish and self-hatred, Ha-Jun clenches his fist tightly over the demonic feather, shaking with suppressed rage
panels.prose_hi: Bebasi, gham aur gusse ke toofan mein, Ha-Jun ne apni mutthi ko us shaitani pankh ke upar poori taqat se bheencha. Uski poori deha sharm aur lachari se kaanp rahi thi.
panels.prose_en: Grief turned to searing self-hatred. Desperate to be strong, his trembling fingers clenched tighter and tighter around the obsidian feather, his knuckles whitening with rage.

panels.action: The sharp obsidian quill of the feather digs into Ha-Jun's scraped knuckle. A crimson drop of his blood wells up and touches the black plume
panels.prose_hi: Pankh ki nok itni teekhi thi ki usne Ha-Jun ki chheeli hui knuckle ko cheer diya. Laal khoon ki ek taaza boond ubhri aur kaale pankh ke reshon se chhoo gayi.
panels.prose_en: The sharp obsidian quill pierced into his bleeding knuckle. A single drop of fresh, pure crimson blood welled up, dripping directly onto the black plumage.

panels.action: The drop of blood does not roll off—it is violently absorbed by the feather! The obsidian plume turns glowing crimson-violet like burning magma
panels.prose_hi: Aur phir wo hua jiski kisi ne kalpana nahi ki thi. Wo khoon baha nahi—balki pankh ne use pyaase ki tarah pee liya! Palak jhapakte hi poora pankh daldalate hue laal aur baingani magma ki tarah dehakne laga!
panels.prose_en: The drop of blood did not run off. In a terrifying instant, the feather devoured it whole! The obsidian quill flared violently, turning into glowing, incandescent crimson-violet magma!

panels.action: Blinding radiant violet mana and purple flame sparks burst outward from his clenched fist! Raindrops are blasted backward in a circular halo
panels.prose_hi: BOOM! Ha-Jun ki bheenchi hui mutthi se baingani mana aur aag ki chingaariyon ka ek prachand dhamaka hua! Ek zordar mana blast ne chhat ki saari baarish ki boondon ko door phek diya!
panels.prose_en: KRRSHHH! An explosive eruption of radiant violet mana and demonic embers detonated from his clenched fist, blasting away the falling rain in a blinding, circular shockwave!

panels.action: Dark purple lightning arcs dance across Ha-Jun's forearm. His bruised cheek and split lip begin emitting white healing steam as wounds vanish

bubbles.text: AUR DEMON SOVEREIGN KA JAADU... USKI RAGON MEIN BEHNE LAGA.

panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke baazu par andheri baingani bijliyan nachne lagi. Uske gaal ke zakhm aur phate hue honth se safed bhaap nikalne lagi, aur saare zakhm jadoo ki tarah gayab hone lage. Demon Sovereign ka khoon uski ragon mein ubalne laga tha!
panels.prose_en: Arcs of crackling purple lightning danced up Ha-Jun's arm into his shoulder. White healing steam hissed from his bruised cheek and split lip, sealing his injuries instantly as the primordial bloodline surged awake within his veins!

panels.action: Low-angle medium close-up: Ha-Jun's eyes snap open, burning with sharp crimson-violet demonic sovereign light. A glowing holographic interface appears: [SOVEREIGN BLOODLINE AWAKENED - 0.1%]
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apni aankhein kholi—ab unme kamzori nahi thi. Uski nigaahon mein ek shaitani samraat ki laal-baingani aag jal rahi thi. Aur uski aankhon ke saamne ek chamakti hui holographic screen ubhar aayi: [SOVEREIGN BLOODLINE AWAKENED - 0.1%]. 'SYSTEM: WELCOME, TRUE SOVEREIGN.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's eyes snapped open—and all weakness was gone. His pupils burned with the fierce, majestic crimson-violet radiance of an ancient Sovereign. Suspended before his vision, a glowing celestial interface materialized: [SOVEREIGN BLOODLINE AWAKENED - 0.1%]. 'SYSTEM: WELCOME, TRUE SOVEREIGN.'
